mathematics.assertion_tested: Every returned vertex-query certificate agrees with complete simulated truth at every observed prefix. Development policy costs are measured on all frozen simulated worlds, with exact finite reference checks on Q3.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact binary graph states, integer flow capacities and integer query costs. Floating point Gaussian and heat fields are thresholded before certification.
mathematics.conventions: See acquisition_protocol_v1.json and acquisition_conventions_v1.json. Median ties are retained; endpoints are forced present.
inputs: Seven finite graphs and 38 graph-field combinations
Two initial conditions and five query policies
All 729 Q3 ternary partial states with both endpoints present
non_claims: Clairvoyant certificate sizes are not implementable predictions
Q3 minimax is a worst case reference, not a pointwise lower bound
